scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,frontend -c cyan,green "uv run uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir server --host localhost --port ${PORT:-8788}" "VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:${PORT:-8788} pnpm --filter @kfl-system-design/frontend dev"
